rows.rule: Episode selection is exactly one existing local video file
rows.validator: ExistingFile, ordered video filters, suffix allow-list
rows.test: contract test plus native Windows picker probe

rows.rule: Supported video extensions are MP4, MOV, MKV, M4V, WEBM, AVI
rows.validator: selected file suffix and one-file cardinality
rows.test: contract test plus native Windows picker fixture

rows.rule: Metadata and timing discovery is local, bounded, and deterministic
rows.validator: relationship score, package identity, ignored backup paths
more than one candidate has no automatic match
metadata source hash must match selected video

rows.rule: User sees five progressive steps, not the internal eight-stage state machine
rows.test: descriptor test plus 18-state Windows screenshot review

rows.rule: Render plans and automated QA are not primary UI actions
rows.test: 68-test matrix plus Windows E2E and screenshot review

rows.validator: existing execution authorization and engine tests

rows.rule: Automatic QA runs after every local render
rows.validator: QA result required before review queue
rows.test: existing workflow QA tests; environment missing jsonschema

rows.rule: Human review remains uninterrupted then detailed and checklist-backed
rows.validator: session.valid, detail inspection, checklist, human receipt
rows.test: existing review tests plus full Desktop E2E

rows.rule: Canonical export remains human-triggered and no-overwrite
rows.validator: existing storage hash and conflict gates
rows.test: existing storage and desktop workflow tests; environment missing jsonschema
